title: Governance Mode
description: Operating mode for a governance agent. Controls whether findings block execution.

enumDescriptions.audit: Log all checks, never block. Findings are recorded but the governance agent always returns approved, except for plans with human_review_required: true, which escalate in every mode.
enumDescriptions.advisory: Flag issues and return findings, but do not block execution. Human reviews happen post-hoc, except for plans with human_review_required: true, which escalate in every mode.
enumDescriptions.enforce: Block on denied or escalated. Require resolution before proceeding.
